integrity: Finite exhaustive verifier corroborates the 13-vertex instance; the infinite theorem is justified by the written parity argument. No external or independent validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: For the infinite family the chromatic parameter is bounded below, not determined exactly. Exact chromatic parameter is proved only for the 13-vertex instance. No smallest-order claim, no classification of all imperfect trees, and no independent mathematical audit; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Parity obstructions to metric general-position perfection of three-arm trees
